name: APT36 C2 1 - HTTP Beacons with Jitter to a Loopback Server (T1071.001)
blast_radius: Runs a loopback-only HTTP server in an in-process runspace and sends five POST beacons about two seconds apart with an uncommon user agent. No traffic leaves the host.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 3: connections to 127.0.0.1 on the beacon port
detection: NDR/EDR: periodic POSTs with a fixed body shape and unusual user agent

name: APT36 Collection 4 - Archive Staging with a Utility (T1560.001)
blast_radius: Archives five synthetic files with tar.exe into a run-tagged zip, lists it and extracts it to confirm every hash matches. Not encrypted. Removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: tar.exe with a run-tagged archive path
detection: EDR: archive utility run on a collection folder by a script host

name: APT36 Lateral Movement 1 - Staging via the Loopback Administrative Share (T1021.002)
blast_radius: Gated by BAS_CONFIRM_APT36_REMOTE_STAGING=true (exact) and administrator only. Creates a run-tagged folder under C:/Users/Public through the loopback C$ share, copies three synthetic files into it, verifies them and removes the folder.
detection: SIEM: file writes over C$ from a non-administration host or process
cleanup:
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $env:PUBLIC '.') -Filter 'bas_a36_*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: APT36 Lateral Movement 2 - WinRM Exposure Check (T1021.006, read-only)
blast_radius: Reads whether the WinRM service is running and has a listener configured; never starts, stops or reconfigures WinRM. Entirely read-only.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: wsmprovhost.exe if remote PowerShell is later used
detection: SIEM: WinRM listener enabled where it should not be
